hero.title: Settings
hero.desc: Manage learning, voice, and backups here. Your Gemini key is managed under Account. AI features share one key; offline games do not need one.

memory.title: Memory
memory.tagline: On by default · Turn off anytime
memory.intro: Koolo Teachers and Friends can remember conversations. Data stays in this browser, but relevant memories may be shared with Gemini in future conversations. Turning memory off stops further use and collection; it does not delete saved memories.
memory.personalDesc: Remember explicitly shared everyday facts, learning goals, interests and preferences for Teachers and Friends.
memory.friendDesc: Each friend and learning language has separate topics. Turning this off stops saving and reusing them.
memory.footnote: Previously disabled settings stay off. Manage or delete existing memories in your Teacher's knowledge or each Friend's shared memories.

backup.title: Data backup
backup.intro: Download stories, learning progress, and saved readings before switching devices or clearing browser data. Keep the backup private. Gemini API keys are never included.
backup.exportSuccess: Backup ready: {{stories}} stories and {{keys}} local entries.
backup.exportError: Backup failed. Check browser storage and try again.
backup.importSuccess: Imported {{stories}} stories and {{entries}} entries; skipped {{skipped}} existing entries. Refresh to update the screen.
backup.footnote: Imports only add missing data. Existing stories and keys are not replaced.

gemini.initialPending: Gemini Key saved, not yet verified.
gemini.keyEmpty: Paste a Gemini API Key first.
gemini.invalid: Invalid Key or insufficient API permission ({{status}})
gemini.keyError: Key unchanged: {{reason}}. Your existing key was kept.
gemini.storageError: Google verified the key, but it could not be saved in this browser. Check storage and try again.
gemini.keySaved: ✓ Gemini Key verified and saved (voice test optional)
gemini.verifiedDesc: Google API verification passed; voice can be tested separately
gemini.unverifiedDesc: Verify this key without granting microphone access
gemini.titleNew: Create a free Gemini API Key to start using Koolo AI
gemini.intro: Koolo's AI-powered features share one key; offline games need no key. Set it up once and verify it; microphone access is optional until you use voice.
gemini.step1Desc: Open Google AI Studio and sign in.
gemini.step2Desc: Choose Create API key, then copy your new key.
gemini.step3Desc: Verify and save. Test your microphone later if needed.
gemini.openStudio: Create a free key with Google ↗
gemini.privacy: Your key stays in this browser. Usage and charges are managed in your Google project.
gemini.voiceTagline: Separate test · Saved Key stays intact
gemini.voiceIntro: Microphone permission is only required for voice features. A valid key does not necessarily mean Gemini Live will connect.
gemini.micStateUnsupported: This browser cannot query permission state
gemini.macHelp: Mac: Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone and allow Microsoft Edge / Chrome. Also allow this site in your browser's address-bar permissions. Quit and reopen the browser after changing the system setting.
gemini.windowsHelp: Windows: Open Settings → Privacy & security → Microphone. Allow microphone and desktop app access, then allow this site in Edge / Chrome.
gemini.genericHelp: Enable microphone access for your browser in system privacy settings and in this site's permissions, then try again.
gemini.voiceDenied: Microphone access was denied. Allow it in your device and site settings. Your saved key has not changed.
gemini.voiceMissing: No microphone found. Check your input device. Your saved key has not changed.
gemini.voiceError: Gemini Live test failed: {{reason}}. Your saved key has not changed.
gemini.diagnosticsDesc: Microphone API support does not mean your system has granted permission. Only the 'Check microphone' button requests access.
gemini.freeTitle: Get a free API Key with your Google account
gemini.freeDesc: Create your own key in Google AI Studio. No Gemini Advanced subscription is needed. Some models have free usage tiers with model-specific limits.
gemini.pricingNote: A free key does not mean unlimited free usage. Free tiers have model-specific limits.
gemini.setupNoticeTitle: No Gemini Key yet? Create one for free
gemini.setupNoticeDesc: Get a key with your Google account in about a minute. One key works across Koolo's AI features; offline games need no key. Free usage varies by model.
gemini.keyCapabilities: No Key needed: text chat with AI friends ({{count}} messages daily), key-free games, Shorts and vocabulary practice. Key needed: voice chat, teacher lessons, story creation and AI fortune readings.
gemini.setupInvalidTitle: Your Gemini Key may not be working
gemini.setupInvalidDesc: Check or re-verify your key, or create another one for free. You'll return to your chat after setup.

device.heading: App & device
device.android: Koolo Android Web Preview: use your camera or gallery for image inputs. Audio permissions are unaffected.
device.browser: You're using Koolo in a browser. Camera and gallery access depend on browser permissions.
device.storage: Native Android, the app WebView and each browser store Gemini keys and learning records separately. They do not sync automatically.
device.permissions: For camera or microphone issues, check Android Settings → Apps → Crew Teacher → Permissions. Access is requested only when needed.

group.learningIntro: These settings apply to your teacher and practice sessions on this device.
group.voiceIntro: Gemini Live is for conversations. Word pronunciation uses your device's speech engine.
group.pronunciationIntro: Choose an on-device English voice, speed, and preview on the vocabulary page.
group.modelIntro: Choose a model to compare voice pronunciation
group.memoryIntro: Review memory use and records stored in this browser or WebView.
group.keyInAccount: Gemini key setup is now under Account. Microphone, voice testing, and playback volume stay here.

deviceApp.title: Device & App
deviceApp.description: Check app capabilities and open Android settings. No permissions are requested here.
deviceApp.browser: Android device actions are unavailable in a regular browser.
deviceApp.legacy: This APK does not support device diagnostics. Other app features remain available.
deviceApp.unavailable: Device information could not be read. Try refreshing.
deviceApp.privacy: Diagnostics remain on this device until you choose to copy them. Koolo service availability is not tested.
deviceApp.actionUnavailable: This settings screen is unavailable on this device.

cyberOrb.title: Cyber Orb · Hands-free chat
cyberOrb.intro: Choose a Koolo character and keep talking while using other Android apps.
cyberOrb.note: End your current voice chat before starting another one or switching characters.
cyberOrb.native_key_required: Finish setting up your Gemini Key, then try again.
cyberOrb.overlay_permission_required: Allow display over other apps, return to Koolo, and tap Start again.
cyberOrb.microphone_permission_required: Allow microphone access, return to Koolo, and tap Start again.
cyberOrb.already_active: An Orb call is already active. End it before choosing another character.
cyberOrb.start_failed: Could not start voice chat. Please try again.
cyberOrb.bridge_error: The connection did not respond. Reopen Koolo.
cyberOrb.unavailable: Cyber Orb is unavailable in this App version.
cyberOrb.web_key_unavailable: Your Gemini Key is not set up yet. Open Settings to finish setup before chatting.
